investigations.description: One row per PSI investigation, flattened from the PSI API record.

start_date.description: MM-DD-YYYY, as in the PSI record; several are wrong (see digest)

contacts.description: investigator names from the PSI record contact block, '; '-separated

author_contacts.description: per-author name, affiliation, role and e-mail from the PSI record contact block

objective.description: objective text from the PSI record

tests.description: One row per test, test day or condition set. Dictionary and caveats: docs/tests-table.md.

test_id.description: test identifier from the source (test no., FLEX no., day code). When the source has none: `<accession>-r<source_row>`

row_kind.description: `test` (one test or burn), `test_day` (one row per day), `condition_set` (one test condition, possibly several runs), `planned` (pre-flight planning matrix, not flown)

date.description: test date (ISO). Null when the source date is missing, garbled or inconsistent

fuel.description: normalised fuel name(s), joined with `/`. For BASS / BASS-II rows whose label names only a shape it is inferred (`fuel_inferred`)

fuel_raw.description: fuel or material text as in the source (or as corrected, see `fuel_raw_original`)

fuel_fraction.description: fuel mole fraction of the fuel stream. For inverse flames (PSI-10, PSI-159 `config = inverse`) it is the ambient (chamber) fuel fraction

config.description: flame or sample configuration (normal / inverse, coflow, droplet, free / fiber-supported droplet, opposed / concurrent flow). For the 20 BASS-II slab tests (M series) it is `opposed flow`, from the summary report

geometry.description: burner, nozzle, sample or droplet size as text

x_o2_ambient.description: O2 mole fraction of the surrounding chamber or cabin atmosphere (single value). Null for inverse flames, whose ambient is fuel + N2

x_o2_burner.description: O2 mole fraction of a burner oxidiser stream (inverse flames)

x_o2_min.description: range of ambient O2 over the row (a day or condition set may list several values). Ambient only: null for inverse flames

x_o2_max.description: range of ambient O2 over the row (a day or condition set may list several values). Ambient only: null for inverse flames

x_o2.description: deprecated, ambiguous; not in `data/export/tests.json`. The single O2 value as first parsed: ambient for most rows but the burner stream for inverse flames. Kept for backward compatibility; use `x_o2_ambient` / `x_o2_burner`

flow_cm_s.description: imposed air or oxidiser flow velocity (single value; null when the flow was ramped through several values)

n_flames.description: flames ignited on a test day

ignited.description: hot ignition yes/no (null for CFI-G "flash"). For PSI-25 only `False`, on the one row (O12) whose air-display cell says "no ign"; for BASS and BASS-II use `outcome`

burn_time_s.description: burn time. For PSI-39 it is the hot-flame burn time. For PSI-25 (M series only) it is the summary report's burn time, given in minutes to 0.1 min

outcome.description: PSI-25 and PSI-26 only, whose tables have no outcome column: how the flame ended, read from the crew's own words. `no_ignition` (never lit, or not sustained once the igniter was withdrawn), `extinguished` (a sustained flame went out with fuel left), `burned_out` (burned until the fuel was gone). Null when the words do not say: 145 of the 250 runs. See "Outcomes read from notes" below

outcome_cause.description: with `extinguished` only: `blowoff` (went out as flow was raised), `low_flow` (went out as flow was reduced or shut off), `nitrogen` (put out by the GN2 flow), `unspecified`

outcome_action.description: with `extinguished` only: what was done to the flow when the flame went out. `flow_reduced` (the flow was turned down and the flame went out at a finite setting: a quenching limit), `flow_shut_off` (the crew stopped the fan or the air to end the run: not a limit), `flow_raised` (blowoff, every `blowoff` row), `nitrogen` (every `nitrogen` row), `none` (went out by itself at constant flow). Null when the words do not say (2 runs)

outcome_setting.description: the setting at which the flame went out, when the source states it: `pot 0.31` (fan potentiometer), `fan 40` (fan display), `gn2 pot 6`. Text as logged, not a velocity: the fan calibration does not reach these settings and was not applied. `extra.outcome_setting_field` names the cell. 31 runs

outcome_quote.description: the words the outcome was read from, verbatim; `extra.outcome_field` names the cell, `extra.outcome_doubt` gives a caveat where the reading is uncertain, `extra.outcome_cause_inferred` marks a cause that rests on the fan and air cells and not on the quoted words (3 runs)

ext_diameter_mm.description: droplet diameter at (hot / visible) flame extinction

burn_rate_k_mm2_s.description: burning-rate constant K (hot flame for PSI-39). PSI-69's "Burning rate; mm" column is K in mm²/s

cool_flame.description: `True` when cool-flame data exist (k_cool, cool-flame extinction diameter or an extrapolated cool flame). Never `False`: missing cool-flame data do not show there was none

spread_rate_mm_s.description: microgravity flame spread rate, one value for the whole test. Null for BASS-II: its rates belong to flow steps within a test and are in `extra.spread_steps` and the `spread_steps` table (see "BASS-II spread rates" below)

flame_length_mm.description: measured flame length: video length, or Nikon still flame height

at_smoke_point.description: the log marks this flame as at its smoke point (`Smoke Height` / `SH ?` Y/N)

smoke_point_reviewed.description: `True` when the row is one of the 55 smoke points of the science team's review (`SmokePointReview-0g-3.xlsx`), matched to this single log row (review values in extra, `review_*`). Never `False`: points between two log rows are flagged `smoke_point_bracket` instead

extra.description: JSON object: uncaptured source cells, `<column>_original` values, notes and provenance

source_file.description: file the row came from, relative to the repo

source_row.description: row number in that file: 1-based data row for CSVs, Excel row number for spreadsheets

discrepancies.description: Curated conflicts between the PSI experiment tables and the raw sensor data, with the action taken. Source: data/corrections/tests_patches.json. See docs/tests-table.md.

id.description: patch id (D01, ...), as listed in tests.extra `discrepancies`

test_id.description: test id as in the PSI table (null for a note on a whole investigation)

test_id_now.description: test id in `tests` after a test_id correction

column.description: `tests` column concerned, or a source column the table keeps only in `extra`

flag.description: flag put on the row; conflicts_with_test_sheet when the only evidence is a hand-filled test sheet (an AI reading of a scan, not checked by a human)

evidence.description: what the raw data or the test sheet show

evidence_source.description: file and channel the evidence comes from

spread_steps.description: BASS-II (PSI-25) flame spread rates of the thick-PMMA slab tests, one row per test and flow step, transcribed from the BASS-II Summary Report, Table 5.1 (data/corrections/tests_spread_bass2.json). Steps of one test are not independent. See docs/tests-table.md.

test_id.description: test id of the `tests` row (M1 ... M20; M6 and M12 have no tracked rate and no row here)

step.description: position of the flow step in the report's list for the test (1 = first listed)

n_steps.description: steps with a spread rate in this test; the independent unit is the test, not the step

flow_cm_s.description: opposed-flow velocity of the step, as the report lists it (cm/s)

spread_rate_mm_s.description: flame spread rate tracked at that step (mm/s)

width_cm.description: sample width as the report gives it (cm); the PSI table says 1 or 2 cm

sides_burning.description: 1 = one side burning (other side on a metal substrate), 2 = both sides

x_o2_initial.description: O2 mole fraction at the start of the test (the `tests` row's x_o2_ambient)

x_o2_final.description: O2 mole fraction at the end of the test; O2 fell during the test and was not measured per step

burn_time_s.description: burn time of the whole test (s), from the report's minutes

source.description: report, table and page the step was transcribed from

source_file.description: with source_row, the key of the `tests` row

source_row.description: with source_file, the key of the `tests` row

test_sheets.description: ACME Science Test Sheets of PSI-10 and PSI-159, one row per page: the form the operators filled in by hand for each test point (ignition, hot or cool flame, soot, how the flame ended, comments). Every value is an AI model's reading of a hand-filled scan (data/transcriptions/), not checked by a human; say so wherever a value is shown. See docs/formats.md.

file_name.description: scanned PDF the page is in (transcription: data/transcriptions/<accession>/<file_name>.md)

page.description: PDF page; one sheet per page

form.description: form title: investigation and flame type

day.description: ACME day code (YYDDD) in the file name

test_id_written.description: id box, as transcribed (with the transcriber's remarks in brackets and after '— note:')

test_id.description: test point: the file's day code and the test letter and number written on the sheet

test_id_basis.description: as_written / day_from_file_name (the day digits on the sheet are wrong or unreadable) / recorded_under_other_id

tests_test_id.description: that row's test_id as `tests` spells it (PSI-159 ids have a space)

has_data_file.description: PSI lists a sensor recording (<test_id>_data.csv) for the test point

date_written.description: test date, as transcribed (with the transcriber's remarks in brackets and after '— note:')

date_parsed.description: date_written as an ISO date, when it is a full date

date_note.description: set when the date written on the sheet is not the day code's date

gmt_written.description: GMT day and time, as transcribed (with the transcriber's remarks in brackets and after '— note:')

test_of_day_written.description: 'Test of day #', as transcribed (with the transcriber's remarks in brackets and after '— note:')

flame_of_day_written.description: 'Flame of day #' ('Hot flame of day #' on CFI-G inverse sheets); says 'no ignition' or 'abort' in words, as transcribed (with the transcriber's remarks in brackets and after '— note:')

test_type_written.description: 'Test type?' (standard, ignition, no-flame, other), as transcribed (with the transcriber's remarks in brackets and after '— note:')

chamber_pressure_written.description: chamber pressure before the test, as transcribed (with the transcriber's remarks in brackets and after '— note:')

chamber_pressure_psia.description: chamber pressure before the test, when one number is written

fuel_flow_written.description: burner fuel flow (normal flames), as transcribed (with the transcriber's remarks in brackets and after '— note:')

fuel_flow_slpm.description: burner fuel flow (normal flames), when one number is written (empty for a ramp)

o2_flow_written.description: burner oxidizer flow (inverse flames), as transcribed (with the transcriber's remarks in brackets and after '— note:')

o2_flow_slpm.description: burner oxidizer flow (inverse flames), when one number is written (empty for a ramp)

n2_flow_written.description: burner nitrogen flow, as transcribed (with the transcriber's remarks in brackets and after '— note:')

n2_flow_slpm.description: burner nitrogen flow, when one number is written (empty for a ramp)

ignited_written.description: 'Ignited?' (yes / no / yes, but ...), as transcribed (with the transcriber's remarks in brackets and after '— note:')

ignited.description: yes / yes_but (ticked 'yes, but ...': momentary or unsustained) / no / unclear; empty when not marked

flame_written.description: 'hot / cool / maybe cool' row (inverse and CFI-G forms), as transcribed (with the transcriber's remarks in brackets and after '— note:')

flame.description: hot / cool / hot+cool / maybe_cool; empty when not marked

flame_behavior_written.description: the other 'Flame' rows (asymmetric, hole/opening, partially detached, oscillating, unsteady, quasi-steady, blew out), '; '-separated, as transcribed (with the transcriber's remarks in brackets and after '— note:')

soot_written.description: single 'Soot' row of the 2019 normal-flame form, as transcribed (with the transcriber's remarks in brackets and after '— note:')

soot_ignition_written.description: 'Soot@ignition', as transcribed (with the transcriber's remarks in brackets and after '— note:')

soot_ignition.description: none / little / lots when exactly one is marked

soot_middle_written.description: 'Soot@middle', as transcribed (with the transcriber's remarks in brackets and after '— note:')

soot_middle.description: none / little / lots when exactly one is marked

soot_end_written.description: 'Soot@end', as transcribed (with the transcriber's remarks in brackets and after '— note:')

soot_end.description: none / little / lots when exactly one is marked

out_written.description: 'Out' row: how the flame ended (ext. detect / time out / temp. limit); not on the 2019 normal-flame form, as transcribed (with the transcriber's remarks in brackets and after '— note:')

out.description: ext_detect (extinction detected: the flame went out) / time_out (lasted the scripted time) / temp_limit (stopped by the burner temperature limit); empty when not exactly one is marked

chamber_pressure_post_psia.description: chamber pressure after the test, when one number is written
